newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Shoprite to sell insurance from outlets.
newsitem.headline: Shoprite to sell insurance from outlets.

text.p: South Africa's Shoprite Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday that it would start selling insurance policies at its supermarkets from Thursday.

The 245-strong supermarket group said it would start with funeral policies in partnership with Old Mutual Group Schemes and the HT Group which includes Goodal & Williams and SAFFAS. The range of products would be expanded in time.
"It is a no-frills products as available as every day baked beans in an environment consumers know and trust with convenient trading hours," managing director Whitey Basson said in a statement.
"More importantly it is 30 to 40 percent cheaper than the average market price for a conventional policy with similar cover," he added.
Shoprite would act as a distribution and payment collections channel but the claim procedure would be handled by the insurers.
The whole exercise was aimed at consumers who were new to insurance products, the group said.
